verdicts.why: Lia calls Andre about Mikayla's overdose after he introduces himself as the group's head in White Lines (#12), but the proposed #16 split also told him draining and abandoning her, which is Two Player (#18); that is split again.
Tandy befriends Lia, shares stories of abuse and is tasered into an ambulance in Alignment Chart (#15); Lia and Andre break her and unload her at the Viking Motel in B Sides (#16).
Lia runs the abuse support group that Tandy and Melissa attend from Restless Energy (#11), where she is in the cast and steers the session.
Mayhem's visits to Delgado (after he quits, outside the liquor store, outside the Glitter Gutter asking his blessing) are flashbacks in Shadow Selves (#13).
Connors prepares to kill Tandy first and she disarms him outside the Roxxon facility in Colony Collapse (#10); she saves him from Mayhem and he escapes the Dark Dimension in Rabbit Hold (#14).
Maximus never had powers to lose: his Terrigenesis turned him into a normal human with no Inhuman powers, so 'lost his powers' is wrong.
In Behold... The Inhumans! (#1) Gorgon is already head of the Royal Guard and Black Bolt sends him to Earth to find Triton; the rescue at Declan's lab and his death are #6.
In #1 Black Bolt reveals he secretly sent Triton to Earth to bring back new Inhumans, and Triton is shot and falls into the sea, presumed dead; he returns and captures Maximus in #7.
In #1 the 'military forces' that shoot Triton are Attilan Royal Guards, and the same team gets a kill order from Maximus that episode; the capture is #7.

split.text: Crystal pretends to agree, then disowns Maximus before the Genetic Council and escapes to Earth with Lockjaw.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Crystal's brother in law, whose rule she defies.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Maximus's sister in law, who defies him.

verdicts.why: The enmity starts earlier than #2: in Behold... The Inhumans! (#1) Maximus has Crystal captured by the Royal Guard and locked in the Quiet Room. His pressing her is #2 and her escape is #3.
The old friendship, Maximus's resentment over Tibor's council seat, and his demand that Tibor prove his loyalty all come in Make Way For... Medusa (#4).
In Divide and Conquer (#3) Maximus sends Locus to Earth with Mordis, Flora, Pulsus and Sakas to back Auran, and they go after Gorgon.
